name: MKI Password Policy
overview: Password rules and forced password changes for Jellyfin users.
description: Enforces password rules (length, character types, no username, common passwords) on the server for every client, with ready-made profiles. Lets an administrator require a new password from all users or from single users: they cannot sign in on any device until they have set one. Optional password expiry, a check at sign-in and a forced change for new users. The web client shows the rules live and a change dialog; TV and native apps use a change page that opens in any browser. Settings page is in German.
